purpose: Machine-readable asset governance policy for locations that intentionally allow untracked generated or local-only files.

rules.rationale: test_data/generated contains rebuildable generated evidence. Registered evidence and state-referenced files must be preserved by cleanup classification before deleting siblings.
data/samples is an intentional local corpus. It stays outside tracked cleanup and atom ledgers unless a sample is promoted into a registered fixture or evidence record.

tmp contains disposable generated reports and scratch outputs only. Required matrix evidence must be promoted to registry/evidence/<topic>; direct cleanup is allowed only for classified rebuildable candidates, and mixed groups require preserve_paths plus explicit producer scope.
